source.commitSubject: fix: bound virtual rows to their public viewport width
source.snapshotMethod: git archive exact committed HEAD with explicit source/config/template/Skill/build/doc/fixture allowlist; extracted into isolated /tmp snapshot; dependency node_modules is read-only symlink

consumers.base: Same bootstrapApplication, standalone OnPush ConsumerApp and generated ActionControl on a native button; explicit import from generated angular/action-control
consumers.collections: Identical bootstrap/base button plus rendered Listbox (virtual, typed CVA), VirtualList (typed VirtualItem context and output bindings), SortableList (typed rows/itemsChange/canMove) and TransferList (typed CVA), explicit imports from the generated public component/model modules
consumers.framework: Client browser ESM; no Zone.js import, router, lazy chunks, app fixtures, server or runtime AI

compiler.perConsumerDifference: Only output directory and selected main.ts input

bundler.treeShaking: esbuild default enabled for bundle ESM; no generated angular/index import

angularLinker.needsLinking: Only matching .mjs inputs; identical gate for both consumers

bundler.matchToRepositoryScript: Same esbuild target/minify/format/sourcemap and Babel linker settings as scripts/build.mjs; measurement changes entrypoints/output directories, enables metafiles and defines ngDevMode/ngJitMode false identically in both scenarios

sizeMethod.raw: Read and stat actual emitted .js/.css output files; cross-check with esbuild metafile.outputs.bytes
sizeMethod.gzip: Node node:zlib gzipSync(actual file Buffer, {level: 9}); sum independently gzipped payload files
sizeMethod.primaryDelta: collections minus base actual minified browser JavaScript payload, including generated collection adapters/model/helpers, Forms, CDK and transitive/shared Angular/RxJS contribution changes; this is not a pure CDK-engine size
sizeMethod.css: Identical generated token/global CSS payload in both builds; component inline styles remain part of the measured JavaScript
excluded: Source maps, compiler output intermediates, metafiles, tarball size and source-input sizes
Network headers, Brotli and browser runtime memory/latency
sizeMethod.esbuildInputAttribution: bytesInOutput > 0 proves compiled/generated/dependency sources contribute to executable output; attribution is explanatory and is not substituted for emitted bundle size or gzip delta

measurementInputs.normalization: Same LF/path normalization as source manifest; paths relative to measurement workspace

scope.generationAndConsistency: Executed the unchanged repository src/cli.ts sync/check commands in the isolated exact-source snapshot using node --import tsx. npm run ui:sync was first attempted and failed because tsx CLI local IPC listen returned EPERM in the sandbox; direct tsx import performs the same generator/check actions without that IPC server

recoveredEnvironmentFailure.reason: tsx CLI local IPC pipe listen EPERM in sandbox

scope.aotAndBundle: Both ngc full AOT/strict-template builds and Angular-linked minified esbuild bundles completed; required generated collection modules have positive executable bytesInOutput
scope.browserOperations: Not executed by this bundle measurement harness; stage browser/AX/axe results remain separate
limits: This is one minimal eager consumer comparison on the fixed Angular/CDK versions and flags, not a universal bundle budget
No pure CDK-only engine size is claimed
No runtime user understanding, screen-reader, touch-device or backend success is inferred from AOT/build success
Long-label width rendering and runtime correctness are verified separately by root; positive AOT/executable adapter retention is static bundle evidence

freshRebuild.reason: Listbox and VirtualList viewport-inline width adapters changed; both minimal consumers and actual payloads were independently regenerated after root generation-heavy interval ended

supplementalBarrelDiagnosis.interpretation: Historical full-AOT public angular/index barrel import retained unused CVA definitions plus Forms/CDK in baseline; primary current measurement uses explicit public generated component-module imports. No fresh 85c5ffde barrel size is claimed.
